def eyes():
    out=[]
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='S':
            bb=n['boundary']; rr=[p[0] for p in bb]; cc=[p[1] for p in bb]
            out.append((min(rr),min(cc)))
    return sorted(out)
for i in range(3):
    action(['UP'])
    r=last_action_result
    print('UP',i+1,'eyes',eyes(),'completed' if r.get('level_completed') else '', 'done' if r.get('done') else '')
    if r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done') or r.get('game_over'): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
